Paploo Taunts for 2 turns at the start of battle, which can't be dispelled. If there were no Galactic Legends at the start of battle, allies ignore Taunt effects while Paploo is Taunting.

Whenever Paploo uses a Special ability, allies gain 50% Defense and Offense (stacking, max 300%) and recover 25% Health and Protection.

Whenever Paploo uses Galvanize, decrease the cooldowns of all Ewok allies by 2.

At the start of encounter, Gamorrean Guard gains 5 stacks of My Kind of Scum, 100% Potency, 50 Speed. Then he gains 20% Counter Chance for each Hutt Cartel ally.

Whenever Gamorrean Guard inflicts a stack of Damage Over Time, he gains Riposte for 2 turns.

While Taunting, he takes 30% reduced damage from enemies with a stack of Damage Over Time or Thermal Detonators.

Whenever Gamorrean Guard removes Turn Meter from an enemy, reduce the cooldown of his abilities by 1.

If the ally in the Leader slot is Hutt Cartel, whenever they use an ability, Mob Enforcer assists, dealing 50% more damage.

At the start of Mob Enforcer's turn, all enemies inflicted with Thermal Detonators are inflicted with Buff Immunity for 1 turn.

Whenever Mob Enforcer attacks out of turn, she always scores a critical hit, if able.

Whenever an enemy critically hits Mob Enforcer, that enemy is inflicted with a stack of Thermal Detonator for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
Whenever Greedo critically hits an enemy, Greedo gains 10% Critical Damage, Defense Penetration, and Offense (stacking, max 200%) until the end of battle.
Whenever another ally recovers Protection, Cad Bane gains Foresight for 1 turn.

Rotta the Hutt's solo effects are active even when he has allies. Whenever Rotta the Hutt critically hits, he gains 10% Critical Chance (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever Rotta uses Knock 'Em Dead, if any enemy is inflicted with Off Balance, Hutt Cartel allies recover 15% Health and Protection. Whenever Rotta defeats an enemy, he gains 10% Offense (stacking, max 80%) until the end of the encounter.
Whenever another ally uses an ability on their turn, TIE Fighter Pilot assists (limit once per turn) dealing 50% more damage.
Whenever an ally takes a bonus turn, all allies recover 20% Health and Protection and Snowtrooper gains 20% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle.
At the start of the encounter, the weakest ally gains 20% Turn Meter for every Light Side ally.

Whenever a Resistance ally falls below 50% Health for the first time, that ally gains Protection Over Time (50%) for 2 turns. Whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit, that ally gains 10% Health Steal (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever any Resistance ally assists, that ally gains 15% Turn Meter. Whenever a Resistance ally defeats an enemy, Resistance allies gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 150%) until the end of the encounter.
Rey (Scavenger) deals +25% more damage per Relic Amplifier level on all allies.
Whenever Light Side allies use a Special ability, they gain Evasion Up, Health Steal Up, and Health Up  for 2 turns.

Whenever a Resistance ally falls below 50% Health for the first time, that ally gains Protection Over Time (50%) for 2 turns. Whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit, that ally gains 10% Health Steal (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever any Resistance ally assists, that ally gains 15% Turn Meter. Whenever a Resistance ally defeats an enemy, Resistance allies gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 150%) until the end of the encounter.
Whenever Dark Side allies use a Basic ability, they gain Critical Chance Up, Critical Damage Up, and Offense Up for 2 turns.

At the start of the encounter and at the end of their turn, First Order allies gain 1 stack of Retaliate (max 3) for 3 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

Retaliate: When damaged by an attack, deal 20% of the damage received per stack to the attacker; this damage can't defeat enemies.
Whenever Dark Side allies use a Basic ability, they gain Critical Chance Up, Critical Damage Up, and Offense Up for 2 turns.

At the start of the encounter and at the end of their turn, First Order allies gain 1 stack of Retaliate (max 3) for 3 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

Retaliate: When damaged by an attack, deal 20% of the damage received per stack to the attacker; this damage can't defeat enemies.

Whenever Rey (Dark Side Vision) inflicts Fear, reduce the cooldowns of First Order allies by 1. Whenever Rey (Dark Side Vision) uses Malevolent Lineage, if all enemies are Shocked, deal bonus damage equal to 20% of their Max Health to all enemies, which can't be evaded. While Rey (Dark Side Vision) is Untargetable, she gains 20% Offense and First Order allies gain 20% Critical Damage.
At the beginning of their turn, Dark Side allies have +25% chance to dispel all debuffs on themself.
At the start of each turn, if non-Galactic Legend Empire allies have 50% or more Turn Meter, damage they receive is reduced by 75% until the end of the turn.
Whenever Grand Moff Tarkin uses an ability, they deal more damage (max 100%) equal to half their Potency percentage. This effect will only trigger if Grand Moff Tarkin has more than 0% Potency.
Whenever Dark Side allies use a Basic ability, they gain Critical Chance Up, Critical Damage Up, and Offense Up for 2 turns.
Whenever a Empire ally falls below 100% Health, they gain a bonus turn. Limit once per character per battle.

At the start of Grand Admiral Thrawn's turn, inflict Damage Over Time on Empire allies for 2 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever an Empire ally gains a debuff, they gain an additional 40% Turn Meter (once per turn) and 40% more damage until the end of the encounter. Whenever an Empire ally uses Maneuver, Empire allies reduce their cooldowns by 1 and gain Critical Hit Immunity, Defense Up, Potency Up, and Tenacity Up for 2 turns, and all enemies lose 15% Turn Meter.
Whenever Light Side allies use a Basic ability, they gain Speed Up for 2 turns.
At the end of each turn, Jedi Vanguard allies recover Health and Protection equal to 50% of the amount enemies recovered that turn. This recovery can't trigger this effect on enemies.
Whenever Dark Side allies inflict a debuff on an enemy, they deal damage to that enemy equal to 2% of that enemy's Max Health.
Whenever a debuff on an enemy expires, Empire allies gain 2% Offense, doubled if that debuff was dispelled, until the end of battle.
Whenever an ally takes a bonus turn, all allies recover 20% Health and Protection and Darth Vader gains 20% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle.
Whenever Dark Side allies inflict a debuff on an enemy, they deal damage to that enemy equal to 2% of that enemy's Max Health.
Whenever a Empire ally falls below 100% Health, they gain a bonus turn. Limit once per character per battle.
Whenever an ally takes a bonus turn, all allies recover 20% Health and Protection and Darth Vader gains 20% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle.
Whenever Light Side allies grant a buff to another ally, that other ally recovers 3% Health and Protection.

Whenever an enemy gains a stack of Investigation, they are Provoked for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted, and Jedi Vanguard allies gain 20% Critical Damage (stacking, max 200%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever an enemy becomes Revealed, that enemy takes True damage equal to 25% of their Max Health and is inflicted with Armor Shred until the end of battle, and all enemies are Exposed for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
Whenever Light Side allies use a Basic ability, they gain Speed Up for 2 turns.
At the start of their first turn, Jedi Vanguard allies gain Offense equal to 400% of their current Defense until the end of battle. Then they lose 50% Defense until the end of battle.
